links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers against NCCN rectal cancer guidelines across clinical domains
links.effect: 127/135 (94.1%) Correct and 121 (89.6%) Accurate; 8 responses (5.9%) partially or wholly incorrect, concentrated in multi-step conditional treatment decision points.
links.quote: Of 135 questions, 127 (94.1%; 95% CI, 88.7-97.0%) were Correct and 121 (89.6%; 95% CI, 83.3-93.7%) were Accurate.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of ChatGPT-4o in answering complex clinical questions based on NCCN guidelines for rectal adenocarcinoma using clinical vignettes, without testing specific deployment safeguards.
